info.title: Lilambd Data for Agents
info.summary: Open-data ledgers and finished answers, paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base) or via RapidAPI plans.
info.description: Every route accepts `sample=1` for a free preview (max 3 rows). Without payment a paid route returns HTTP 402 with a base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 v2). Resend with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`. Every response carries data_as_of, sources and licence metadata.
